propositions: _paged_search loop has no stall guard and spins forever when the server ignores or repeats startAt offsets, reaching only its unbounded exit at a harness cap rather than detecting offset advancement failure

Fail-open exception handlers at get_parent_map and three fetch_snapshot enrichment sites swallow any stall error raised by the pager, converting it into silent degradation instead of propagating the abort loudly
The pager must raise on ANY repeated page (short or full), not adopting fetcher's short-page branch, because DC's page capping makes short pages the normal case with more data to give

Stall error must be defined in core/_backend.py so both the DC adapter and fetcher can name it without layering inversion, with re-raises at all four fail-open sites to prevent silent snapshot degradation
Runaway pagination on a startAt-ignoring stub must terminate within 2 calls after raising BackendPaginationStallError, with the error escaping get_parent_map and all three fetcher handlers
